up: Retrieve all IC50 bioactivity data in nM for the compound CHEMBL2403108 (Ceritinib) and all of its related salts. Use the molecule_hierarchy table to include the parent compound (identified by parent_molregno) and all children (salts) derived from it. The data must be against target CHEMBL4247 (ALK tyrosine kinase receptor). Return the following columns for every matching activity: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
sql:
WITH
RELEVANT_COMPOUNDS AS (
  SELECT
    parent.molregno,
    parent.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON child.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2403108'
  UNION
  SELECT
    parent.molregno,
    parent.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON parent.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2403108'
)
SELECT
  rc.compound_chembl_id,
  rc.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM RELEVANT_COMPOUNDS rc
JOIN compound_records cr ON rc.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4247'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
